_walkers: #623. Both lock to the ore train's 47 s, so no one ever meets on screen. The train is on screen 4.5-14.5 s and through the bay door at ~11 s. The hand (27.8 s walk, offset -31) walks in at 33 s and into the bay ~4 s ahead of the train; the clerk (30.3 s, offset -12) steps out of the bay at 15 s, just as the hopper vanishes inside, and is gone by 38 s. Screen boxes keep >140 px from the train's and ~30 px from each other.
